globalSettings.sceneBoundaryRule: scene-n final frame and scene-(n+1) opening frame should begin from the same state before motion continues
globalSettings.style: warm observational pet webtoon motion, bright daytime Tancheon riverside, readable geography, comic anecdote tone
globalSettings.negativePromptCommon: text, letters, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermarks, wrong pet identity, wrong fur color, wrong ear shape, extra limbs, broken anatomy, uncanny faces, predator-prey violence, drowning panic, injured ducks, blurry
globalSettings.compositionRule: Keep Jjiroo and Jjonga identical to the approved storyboard and keyframe plan. Preserve the same Tancheon riverside geography from duck sighting to water entry to climb-out bank. Keep generated frames text-free and comic rather than dangerous.

providerExpectations.keyframeGate: Use the approved keyframe plan and storyboard bundle as the visual lock before generating any scene video.
providerExpectations.pictureStage: Generate mute picture-only clips first, then hand off to POST for narration, SFX, BGM, typography, and final assembly.
providerExpectations.continuityRule: Scene-01 starts from keyframes/kf-01.jpg. Scene-02 through scene-10 start from the prior scene handoff frame and aim toward the approved next keyframe pose card without resetting geography.
providerExpectations.textRule: Do not bake captions, CTA, labels, or any readable text into generated frames.
providerExpectations.sceneDelivery: Each completed scene should yield one picture clip, one provider manifest, and one extracted last-frame asset for the next handoff.

_note: Pet-contents storyboard-first path. Render the 10-scene picture chain sequentially with preserved riverside geography and exact scene-boundary continuity.

futureScenes.cameraIntent: gentle opening pan over a calm riverside walk
futureScenes.providerExpectation: Open on a clean, bright Tancheon establishing beat that immediately locks the mother, Jjiroo, Jjonga, and the river path in the same readable world.
continuityNotes: Use the same harness colors and pet silhouettes as the storyboard lock.
The river, dirt path, and walking direction become the baseline geography for every later scene.

futureScenes.cameraIntent: subtle dog-height handheld drift with slice-of-life detail
futureScenes.providerExpectation: Stay close to the dogs and sell relaxed sniffing behavior without changing the environment logic or pet identity.
continuityNotes: Begin from the same walking state as scene-01 final frame before lowering into sniffing behavior.
Keep the mother secondary and the riverbank relationship unchanged.

futureScenes.cameraIntent: tiny push-in on Jjiroo's duck-lock reaction
futureScenes.providerExpectation: Make the duck sighting unmistakable while keeping Jjiroo foregrounded and the ducks readable in the same location they will escape from later.
continuityNotes: The ducks must appear at the same resting zone that later connects to the chase and water entry.
Jjonga remains secondary and calm; no sudden breed or scale drift.

futureScenes.cameraIntent: slow lateral creep during a coiled stalking hold
futureScenes.providerExpectation: Build pre-sprint tension through posture, leash strain, and eye-line only; hold geography steady so the later burst feels like one continuous action.
continuityNotes: Jjiroo's crouch direction must match the sprint direction in scene-05.
Do not let the ducks relocate or the bank shape change between scenes.

futureScenes.cameraIntent: aggressive diagonal chase frame with a sudden acceleration release
futureScenes.providerExpectation: Explode from the stalking hold into a fast but readable sprint toward the river, with ducks scattering and the mother clearly lagging behind.
continuityNotes: Keep Jjonga back on shore and out of the pursuit lane.
The final frame should land at the exact bank edge that becomes the splash point in scene-06.

futureScenes.cameraIntent: fast drop into a splash impact at the same bank edge
futureScenes.providerExpectation: Scale the incident up by putting Jjiroo into the water immediately, but keep the entry point crystal clear and non-threatening.
continuityNotes: The opening frame must exactly match scene-05's final sprint state before the water impact continues.
Keep the splash comic and energetic, not panicked or dangerous.

futureScenes.cameraIntent: forward chase framing with layered depth from shore into river
futureScenes.providerExpectation: Reveal the mother entering after Jjiroo without losing the fact that Jjiroo is already ahead and in control of the frame.
continuityNotes: The mother enters from the same water entry area established in scene-06.
Jjiroo stays the emotional center; the mother is a rescue context, not the lead.

futureScenes.cameraIntent: vertical tracking follow along the river lane
futureScenes.providerExpectation: Sustain the absurdity by showing Jjiroo swimming confidently ahead while the ducks clear out and the mother cannot close the gap.
continuityNotes: Distance between Jjiroo and the mother should widen without making the scene feel like an emergency.
By the end of the scene, Jjiroo begins redirecting from chase mode toward the climb-out bank.

futureScenes.cameraIntent: easing pullback toward the self-rescue climb-out point
futureScenes.providerExpectation: Make Jjiroo's self-rescue legible and satisfying by landing him on the same readable bank system established earlier in the chase.
continuityNotes: The climb-out bank must feel like the same river geography, not a reset to a new shoreline.
End with Jjiroo fully on land and turning his attention back toward the mother.

futureScenes.cameraIntent: mostly locked comedy hold with a tiny head-tilt reaction
futureScenes.providerExpectation: Land the clean final laugh by holding on Jjiroo safe on the bank, dripping and puzzled, with the soaked mother behind him in the water.
continuityNotes: Begin from the exact climb-out state reached in scene-09; only minimal facial and head movement should be added.
Leave room for the final lower-third caption in POST and keep the frame completely text-free.
